column2: # QQ-plot does suggest normality for both case and control, a shapiro-wilk test will confirm this finding
# for case, the p value is 0.2129, no evidence against normality
# for ctrl, the p value is 0.007452, strong evidence against normality

# to do a t-test, both group need to meet the normality assumption, since the ctrl group has violated the assumption, Wilcoxon rank-sum test will be applied here to compare the two groups instead of t-test.
Wilcoxon rank sum test with continuity correction

# the wilcoxon test statistics value is 15554 with a p-value of 1.013e-08. This suggests a extremely strong evidence that the PRS distribution differ between the Pakinson disease case group and the control group, with case group have higher PRS compare to the control group.
